args.text:
Hi Marcus. I've held off saving this one for now. Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June, or the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead, so a mail to him with the Thornbury rate needs sign-off from Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark first, even as a draft you'd send yourself. I've logged an approval request with June (deal desk). I don't have a DM open with her, so could you ping her or Anselm to approve it? Once one of them does, I'll save this draft:

To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
Subject: Thornbury 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,

For the territory review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury Cloth Co. is $2,101 a seat. This comes from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.

Thanks,
Marcus

I haven't saved the draft to Hollis yet because it needs approval first.

Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June Osei-Lark (deal desk) or the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead, so a mail to him with the Thornbury rate needs Anselm's or June's approval, even as a draft you'd send yourself.

- **Approval request:** I logged it with `request_approval`, naming June, and asked for it in a reply under your message here. Only you and I are in that thread, and I don't have a direct message open with June, so she won't see it. Please ask her or Anselm to approve it.
- **Draft text:** I wrote it out and put it in that reply. To Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), subject "Thornbury 2027 rate". It gives the proposed 2027 rate of $2,101 a seat and says the figure is from your call yesterday and isn't in any document yet. Once June or Anselm approves, I'll save it in your drafts for you to send.
Heads up, I am out from 2 pm today; ping me before then if you need anything from me.
Thanks, Pree. Noted that you're out from 2 pm today. I don't need anything from you right now. If something comes up that needs you, I'll ping you before 2.

I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I told her I'd noted she's out from 2 pm today, that I don't need anything from her right now, and that I'll ping her before 2 if something comes up.

I didn't look through the channel or her accounts for open items first, so "nothing needed right now" means I had nothing pending for her. It doesn't mean I checked and found nothing.
Yes, approved. Hollis can have the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate, $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. Go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
